title: Domain-mixed proxy sampling with slot preservation for calibration packs
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Design and build a per-domain calibration pack curation pipeline that preserves prompt slot structure, balances head and tail signal via proxy sampling, and produces deterministic holdouts for FP8/INT8 calibration and accuracy validation.
motivation: Current calibration packs over-index on high-frequency prompt templates and lose structural diversity (templated slots), which causes undercoverage of slot-specific token distributions and leads to larger accuracy regressions when quantizing to INT8/FP8. We need a curated, reproducible sampling strategy that captures both volume and rare but high-impact intents per domain.
proposal_summary: Create a pipeline that: (1) assigns importance weights per request using recency, volume, customer-impact, and failure-signal; (2) identifies prompt templates and preserves slot placeholders during exemplar selection; (3) applies rarity-boost smoothing and diversity re-ranking using embeddings; (4) reserves deterministic anchor and holdout subsets for per-quantization validation; (5) augments with paraphrase/synthetic fills only where slot cardinality is insufficient.
sampling_strategy: Steps: 1) Traffic fingerprinting: compute domain + template hash and slot schema for each production prompt. 2) Weighting: base weight = request_count^(0.7) * recency_decay(30d) * (1 + error_signal*5) * customer_impact_factor. 3) Slot-preserved exemplar mining: for each template, retain slot placeholders and select examples that maximize unique slot value coverage. 4) Rarity boost: apply power-law smoothing to increase sampling probability for low-frequency intents (alpha=0.5). 5) Embedding diversity: cluster candidate exemplars per template using 1536-d embedding; pick top-K per cluster to maximize semantic spread. 6) Synthetic expansion: only for templates where unique slot values < threshold (T=10), generate paraphrases or slot swaps using constrained LM prompting and validate against grammar/intent classifier. 7) Anchor and holdout split: deterministic split by stable hash (anchor=10%, holdout=10%, train=80%).
pack_composition_targets: Per-domain pack targets: total 2k-10k exemplars depending on domain size. Composition: head templates 60% (frequency-weighted), long-tail 30% (rarity-boosted), anchors 10% (stable high-impact examples). Maintain minimum 5 unique slot values per templated prompt when possible.
validation_criteria: Validation runs for each quantization profile (INT8/FP8): 1) Metrics: top-1 token accuracy, log-prob shift, and downstream task accuracy (where applicable). 2) Thresholds: median token-level KL divergence vs fp32 <= 0.02; downstream accuracy drop <= 0.5% absolute; worst-case template category drop <= 1.0% absolute. 3) Statistical confidence: bootstrap 95% CI for accuracy delta must exclude regressions beyond thresholds. 4) Regression detection: alert if any anchor example crosses a configured mismatch threshold (eg. prediction class changes or hallucination increase >2x).
rollout_plan: 1) Implement pipeline in calibration service; run nightly sample generation for target domains. 2) Pilot: pick 5 domains (payment, search, docs-summarization, conversational-support, embeddings-heavy) and generate packs; run INT8/FP8 calibration and validation. 3) Review with ML/Research and Product for quality signoff. 4) Automate alerts that gate quantization rollouts in staging. 5) Gradual release: apply quantized model to 5% traffic with fallback and monitoring for 48h before expanded rollout.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: synthetic paraphrases introduce distributional artifacts. Mitigation: strict classifier and perplexity filter + human spot-checks for high-impact templates. Risk: slot preservation may leak PII. Mitigation: PII scrub step before exemplar selection and retention of only anonymized slot tokens and hashed identifiers. Risk: overfitting anchors. Mitigation: rotate anchors quarterly and maintain holdout for sanity checks.
deliverables: 1) Sampling service component with slot schema extractor and weighting engine. 2) Per-domain pack generator with embedding-diversity selection. 3) Automated validation suite that runs INT8/FP8 calibration and emits a report. 4) Documentation and runbook for debugging calibration failures.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Generated packs for pilot domains follow composition targets and pass schema/PII checks. 2) Validation suite runs end-to-end and produces KPIs; INT8/FP8 deltas meet thresholds for at least 4/5 pilot domains. 3) Code reviewed and infra deployed to calibration namespace. 4) Playbook exists for investigating anchor failures.
progress_updates: 2025-05-14: Kickoff with Research and Privacy; agreed on PII scrub pipeline and slot schema definition.
2025-05-21: Implemented template hash + slot extractor; ran initial analysis on 12 domains to compute template cardinalities.
2025-05-28: Prototyped weighting formula and rarity-boost; found power-law alpha=0.5 gives better tail coverage in small domains.
2025-06-02: Embedding clustering integrated; synthetic paraphrase module sandboxed with constraints. Running pilot generation for 5 domains tonight.
notes: This ticket emphasizes preserving templated prompt structure (slot placeholders) because token-level quantization errors often concentrate on slot token distributions (IDs, numerics, named entities). The approach trades some raw frequency fidelity for structural coverage to reduce worst-case regressions when moving to narrow FP formats.
